name: Repo Builder
description: Detects manifests, generates build.sh, and compiles the repository in sandbox.

skills.name: Inspect Manifests
skills.description: Identify language, build system, and dependencies from project manifests.
examples: Detect build manifests and required compilers in the repository

skills.name: Craft build script
skills.description: Generate outputs/build/build.sh with debug symbols and sanitizers when supported.
examples: Write build.sh enabling ASan/UBSan for C/C++ or setting up managed runtimes

skills.name: Execute build script
skills.description: Run build.sh, fix missing packages, smoke-test target, and write outputs/build/status.json.
examples: Compile target in sandbox and verify readiness in status.json
